plan.title: Gradient accumulation with micro-batches
plan.description: Accumulate gradients over micro-batches that fit in memory, then take a single optimizer step. This reduces peak activation memory from full-batch to micro-batch size.
plan.risk: Accumulated gradients must be summed (not averaged) to preserve SGD update equivalence; no mixed-precision policy is enabled, so FP32 precision preserved. Verification must confirm loss match and parameter update equivalence.

plan.title: Enable gradient accumulation via micro-batches
plan.description: Add --micro-batch argument; split each batch into micro-batches, run forward/backward per micro-batch accumulating gradients, then single optimizer.step(). Preserves exact loss reduction (mean over full batch), parameter updates, optimizer settings, data order, RNG, and update cadence.
plan.risk: Requires batch divisible by micro_batch; micro-batch loop adds Python overhead. Must verify loss scaling matches original full-batch mean. Gradient accumulation not yet tested on this codebase.

plan.title: Activation checkpointing on ResidualBlock forward
plan.description: Wrap each ResidualBlock.forward with torch.utils.checkpoint.checkpoint to discard intermediate activations during forward and recompute during backward. This reduces peak activation memory proportionally to depth while preserving exact numerics and optimizer behavior.
plan.risk: Recompute cost ~2x forward FLOPs for checkpointed blocks; may need depth >= 2 to amortize. Verify backward scalar count and logical updates match original exactly.

plan.title: Activation checkpointing in ResidualBlock
plan.description: Wrap ResidualBlock._forward_impl with torch.utils.checkpoint.checkpoint(use_reentrant=False) to trade compute for activation memory. Requires --micro-batch CLI arg and micro-batch loop in training step. Width=256, depth=8, batch=32, micro_batch=16 => 2 micro steps.
plan.risk: Recompute forward twice per micro-batch; verify loss/grad equivalence and numerical parity with original eager forward. Preserve optimizer step cadence, RNG, data order, and all parameter updates.

plan.title: Add gradient-accumulation micro-batch option
plan.description: Introduce --micro-batch argument; split batch into micro-batches, run forward/backward per micro-batch, accumulate gradients, then single optimizer.step(). Preserves original loss reduction (mean over full batch), update cadence, RNG, parameter eligibility, and optimizer settings.
plan.risk: Requires batch divisible by micro_batch; adds Python loop overhead; must preserve exact mean-squared-error scaling and single step() per logical update.

plan.title: Gradient-accumulation micro-batches
plan.description: Add --micro-batch CLI option to split the batch into micro-batches; run forward/backward per micro-batch and accumulate gradients, then single optimizer.step(). Keeps full-batch semantics; no model/layer changes.
plan.risk: Requires batch divisible by micro_batch; gradient accumulation must preserve loss scaling (loss = loss_raw / acc_steps) matches original full-batch mean reduction. Seed/RNG and parameter update eligibility unchanged.

requests.detail: Host must confirm allow_batch_grad_accum policy is enabled; candidate requires it.
Need to confirm micro-batch divisor logic and loss scaling (loss = loss_raw / acc_steps) matches original full-batch mean reduction.

plan.title: Disable AdamW foreach path (use fused or standard)
plan.description: Replace torch.optim.AdamW with foreach=False to avoid the per-parameter temporary buffers created by _foreach_sqrt in the foreach implementation, which appear at the peak (stk_6b2659d9a2fa87d7). This change keeps the same optimizer hyperparameters and update semantics.
plan.risk: Numerical equivalence not proven; verification will compare full backward scalar series for 20 steps against the original OOM run's captured losses. Roundoff differences may appear.

requests.detail: Available text shows optimizer hyperparameters and step counts, but per-step allocation sizes for optimizer state (especially foreach temporary buffers) are not provided. Need measured allocation bytes per optimizer step to quantify foreach overhead.

Logical update count is observed as 20, but confirmation that foreach=False preserves exactly 20 observed optimizer updates with identical parameter tensors updated per step is needed for verification equivalence.

plan.title: Remove retain_graph=True from backward call
plan.description: Change loss.backward(retain_graph=True) to loss.backward() at train.py:104 so the autograd graph is freed after each step. This eliminates the accumulation of forward activations across all 20 steps which causes the peak to reach ~24.8 GiB.
plan.risk: Loss is a scalar; no second-ordered per-step via (predictions - targets).square().mean(). The graph is not reused within or across steps. The only semantic change is freeing intermediate activations earlier. Verify loss values and parameter updates match.

plan.title: Add max_split_size_mb=128 to torch.cuda.set_per_process_memory_fraction
plan.description: Insert `torch.cuda.set_per_process_memory_fraction(1.0, device=0); torch.cuda.memory._set_allocator_settings('max_split_size_mb=128')` after imports and before model creation to limit the allocator's max split size, reducing the reserved-allocated cache gap that drives peak reservation to ~19.8 GB while allocated is only ~5 GB.
plan.risk: Allocator setting is PyTorch version dependent; may have no effect on 2.5.1 or change fragmentation behavior. Does not alter model, optimizer, precision, loss, RNG, or update cadence.
